evidence: Area-selective deposition of WS2 nanolayers is enabled using a ABC-type plasma-enhanced ALD process involving acetylacetone (Hacac) as inhibitor (A), bis(tert-butylimido)-bis(dimethylamido)-tungsten as precursor (B), and H2S plasma as the co-reactant (C) at a low deposition temperature of 250 °C.
